starting_state: A cell administrator needs to export selected records or assets, inspect an external bundle, import it, or decide whether imported content may become locally usable.
preconditions: selected records, runs, templates, environments, or descriptors
a verifiable manifest, hashes, versions, size bounds, dependencies, and local authority context.
intention: Move verifiable records and assets across cell boundaries while preserving provenance and withholding local usability until governed adoption.
job: Preview and export a bounded bundle, verify and import it atomically, keep imported content isolated and inert, and deliberately adopt or reject each asset.
authority_requirements: Attributable actor context and role resolution
Policy digest binding against active snapshot
expected_consequential_state_transitions: Local selected content becomes an export bundle
verified external bundle becomes isolated imported history and inert assets
an inert verified asset becomes locally usable only after adoption
invalid input becomes rejected with the existing cell unchanged.
settlement_condition: The transfer is either rejected atomically or admitted with provenance intact and assets inert; a separately authorized adoption is required before local usability.
expected_next_decisions_and_affordances: repair or replace an incompatible bundle
applicable_failure_and_recovery_behavior: Reject tampered, incomplete, oversized, semantically invalid, or incompatible bundles before partial admission
never count imported history as local capability proof.
